notes.title: Update: v0.1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Update v1.2.0[/b]
- It is now possible to see the Level Ranking on the Level Results screen.
- Added input buffer to increase responsiveness with the controls.
- It is now possible to toggle the window mode using Alt+Return.
- Fixed bug where you would fly backwards while landing stunts.
- Mild performance increase in-game.
- Enhanced inertia.
- Fixed multiple errors on the asian languages localization.

[b]Bananitro YT OST[/b]
The Official Bananitro Soundtrack is now available on YouTube!!!
[previewyoutube=-lO34s1KAGM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
- New keyboard layout option, where you can change the controls on the keyboard.
- Fixed bug where Xbox gamepads would have the incorrect inputs.
- Fixed bug where some elements of the game would not pause.
- Fixed bug where it is not possible to save the current language.
- Fixed bug where the language code showed up on the settings instead of the actual language.
- Fixed crash caused by the snow barrier.
- Fixed the time formatting on the level select and ranking screens.
- Fixed the time formatting on the speedrun time not wrapping around 60 seconds.
- Localized jump tutorial for gamepads.
- Made it possible to navigate through horizontal menus with the shoulder buttons on the gamepad.
- Made it so it is now possible to see the level number on the pause menu and level results.
- Made the shift key icon more obvious.
- Made the enter key confirm buttons on the ui.
- Made the game pause when the window is inactive.
- Made the game start in fullscreen.
- Multiple fixes on the localization.
